9	/-!
10	# Certified base change on the widened cover (R2, human decision I-0492)
11	
12	The seven certificate clauses of `AffAdaptation.IsCertified` transport along an arbitrary test
13	change `R → R'`.  This is the last structural piece the widened value needed: without it
14	`DivFamZarAff` is a type with no functoriality, and nothing downstream can base-change a
15	widened class.
16	
17	## Two definitional identities do most of the work
18	
19	Both were probed and hold on the nose, which is why this file is short:
20	
21	* the base-changed overlap **is** the preimage of the overlap
22	  (`(D.baseChange R').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange R').pieces j = relCurveMap ⁻¹ᵁ (pieces i ⊓
23	  pieces j)` by `rfl`, since `⁻¹ᵁ` commutes with `⊓` definitionally on `Opens`);
24	* the pulled colength **is** the quotient `relQuotBaseChangeAff` lands in.
25	
26	So the widened colength and overlap transports are the SAME declaration
27	(`AffCoverData.pieceQuotBaseChange`) at two different opens, where the chart-typed layer
28	needed `pieceQuotBaseChange` and a separately-constructed `ovlQuotBaseChange` conjugated
29	through the overlap generator.
30	
31	## What is reused verbatim
32	
33	Clauses (c2)/(c3)/(c4) ride the abstract `FlatCokernel` keystones
34	(`LinearMap.ker_lTensor_eq_of_flat_coker`, `LinearMap.tensorKerEquivOfFlatCoker`,
35	`LinearMap.quotRangeBaseChangeEquiv`) and the two square-transport lemmas
36	(`LinearEquiv.map_ker_of_comp_eq`, `LinearEquiv.range_eq_map_range_of_comp_eq`).  All are
37	stated for bare modules and know nothing about covers, so the widening does not touch them.
38	
39	## Main declarations
40	
41	* `AffAdaptation.colengthBaseChange`, `ovlColengthBaseChange` — the (c1) and overlap
42	  transports, both `AffCoverData.pieceQuotBaseChange`.
43	* `AffAdaptation.chartProdBaseChange`, `ovlProdBaseChange` — the product transports.
44	* `AffAdaptation.delta_baseChange_comm` — `δ`-naturality, a `funext` over the pair index.
45	* `AffAdaptation.gluedBaseChange` and the (c2)/(c3)/(c4) transports.
46	* `AffAdaptation.isCertified_pullback` — **the certificate base-changes**, all seven clauses.
47	-/
48	
49	set_option autoImplicit false
50	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
51	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
52	
53	universe u
54	
55	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory TopologicalSpace
56	open Opposite TensorProduct
57	
58	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
59	
60	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
61	
62	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
63	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
64	variable (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra k R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']
65	
66	namespace AffAdaptation
67	
68	variable {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
69	variable (A : AffAdaptation D d) (hproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (A.colength j))
70	
71	/-! ## The colength transports (clause (c1)) -/
72	
73	/-- **Base change of a piece colength**: `R' ⊗[R] colength j ≃ₐ[R'] (pullback).colength j`.
74	This is `AffCoverData.pieceQuotBaseChange` at the singleton `{eqn j}`; the target is
75	definitionally the pulled colength. -/
76	noncomputable def colengthBaseChange (j : D.index) :
77	    R' ⊗[R] A.colength j ≃ₐ[R'] (A.pullback R' hproj).colength j :=
78	  (D.pieceQuotBaseChange R' j {A.eqn j}).trans
79	    (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq R' (by rw [Set.image_singleton]; rfl))
80	
81	/-- (c1) transport, finiteness. -/
82	theorem finite_colength_pullback (hfin : ∀ j, Module.Finite R (A.colength j)) (j : D.index) :
83	    Module.Finite R' ((A.pullback R' hproj).colength j) := by
84	  haveI := hfin j
85	  exact Module.Finite.equiv (A.colengthBaseChange R' hproj j).toLinearEquiv
86	
87	/-- (c1) transport, projectivity. -/
88	theorem projective_colength_pullback (j : D.index) :
89	    Module.Projective R' ((A.pullback R' hproj).colength j) := by
90	  haveI := hproj j
91	  exact Module.Projective.of_equiv (A.colengthBaseChange R' hproj j).toLinearEquiv
92	
93	/-- **Base change of an overlap colength**.  The SAME declaration as the piece transport, at
94	the open `pieces i ⊓ pieces j` — no overlap generator, no conjugation.  Requires the overlap
95	to be affine, which is a hypothesis rather than a field: `AffCoverData` demands affineness of
96	the pieces only, and overlaps are affine when the relative curve is separated. -/
97	noncomputable def ovlColengthBaseChange
98	    (hinf : ∀ i j : D.index, IsAffineOpen (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)) (i j : D.index) :
99	    R' ⊗[R] A.ovlColength i j ≃ₐ[R'] (A.pullback R' hproj).ovlColength i j :=
100	  (relQuotBaseChangeAff C R' (hinf i j)
101	      {relResAlgHom C R (inf_le_left : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces i) (A.eqn i),
102	       relResAlgHom C R (inf_le_right : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces j) (A.eqn j)}).trans
103	    (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq R' (by
104	      rw [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton]
105	      exact congrArg₂ (fun x y => Ideal.span {x, y})
106	        (relAffSectionsMap_res C R'
107	          (inf_le_left : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces i) (A.eqn i)).symm
108	        (relAffSectionsMap_res C R'
109	          (inf_le_right : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces j) (A.eqn j)).symm))
110	
111	/-! ## The computation rules of the two transports -/
112	
113	lemma colengthBaseChange_one_tmul_mk (j : D.index) (t : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)) :
114	    A.colengthBaseChange R' hproj j
115	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn j}) t) =
116	      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {(A.pullback R' hproj).eqn j})
117	        (D.piecesMap R' j t) := by
118	  rw [colengthBaseChange, AlgEquiv.trans_apply,
119	    AffCoverData.pieceQuotBaseChange_one_tmul_mk, Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq_mk]
120	
121	lemma ovlColengthBaseChange_one_tmul_mk
122	    (hinf : ∀ i j : D.index, IsAffineOpen (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)) (i j : D.index)
123	    (t : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)) :
124	    A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' hproj hinf i j
125	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] Ideal.Quotient.mk (A.ovlIdeal i j) t) =
126	      Ideal.Quotient.mk ((A.pullback R' hproj).ovlIdeal i j)
127	        (relAffSectionsMap C R' (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) t) := by
128	  rw [ovlColengthBaseChange, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, relQuotBaseChangeAff_one_tmul_mk]
129	  exact Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq_mk R' _ _
130	
131	/-! ## The product transports -/
132	
133	/-- Base change of the product of piece colengths. -/
134	noncomputable def chartProdBaseChange :
135	    R' ⊗[R] A.chartProd ≃ₗ[R'] (A.pullback R' hproj).chartProd :=
136	  (TensorProduct.piRight R R' R' (fun j : D.index => A.colength j)).trans
137	    (LinearEquiv.piCongrRight fun j => (A.colengthBaseChange R' hproj j).toLinearEquiv)
138	
139	/-- Base change of the product of overlap colengths. -/
140	noncomputable def ovlProdBaseChange
141	    (hinf : ∀ i j : D.index, IsAffineOpen (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)) :
142	    R' ⊗[R] A.ovlProd ≃ₗ[R'] (A.pullback R' hproj).ovlProd :=
143	  (TensorProduct.piRight R R' R'
144	      (fun p : D.index × D.index => A.ovlColength p.1 p.2)).trans
145	    (LinearEquiv.piCongrRight fun p =>
146	      (A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' hproj hinf p.1 p.2).toLinearEquiv)
147	
148	lemma chartProdBaseChange_tmul_apply (r' : R') (s : A.chartProd) (l : D.index) :
149	    A.chartProdBaseChange R' hproj (r' ⊗ₜ[R] s) l =
150	      A.colengthBaseChange R' hproj l (r' ⊗ₜ[R] s l) := by
151	  rw [chartProdBaseChange, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, TensorProduct.piRight_apply,
152	    TensorProduct.piRightHom_tmul]
153	  rfl
154	
155	lemma ovlProdBaseChange_tmul_apply
156	    (hinf : ∀ i j : D.index, IsAffineOpen (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j))
157	    (r' : R') (s : A.ovlProd) (p : D.index × D.index) :
158	    A.ovlProdBaseChange R' hproj hinf (r' ⊗ₜ[R] s) p =
159	      A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' hproj hinf p.1 p.2 (r' ⊗ₜ[R] s p) := by
160	  rw [ovlProdBaseChange, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, TensorProduct.piRight_apply,
161	    TensorProduct.piRightHom_tmul]
162	  rfl
163	
164	/-! ## The overlap-restriction squares
165	
166	The chart-typed proofs of these consumed `ovlMap_resHom_left`/`_right`, which conjugate through
167	the overlap generator.  Widened, the corresponding fact is `relAffSectionsMap_res` — plain
168	`appLE` naturality at `pieces i ⊓ pieces j`. -/
169	
170	section Squares
171	
172	/-- The left overlap-restriction map on a residue class (the widened mirror of the `private`
173	`toOvlLeft_mk` of `DivisorFamilyPullbackCert.lean`). -/
174	private lemma toOvlLeft_mk' (i j : D.index) (t : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i)) :
175	    A.toOvlLeft i j (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn i}) t) =
176	      Ideal.Quotient.mk (A.ovlIdeal i j) (relResAlgHom C R inf_le_left t) :=
177	  rfl
178	
179	/-- The right overlap-restriction map on a residue class. -/
180	private lemma toOvlRight_mk' (i j : D.index) (t : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)) :
181	    A.toOvlRight i j (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn j}) t) =
182	      Ideal.Quotient.mk (A.ovlIdeal i j) (relResAlgHom C R inf_le_right t) :=
183	  rfl
184	
185	variable (hinf : ∀ i j : D.index, IsAffineOpen (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j))
186	
187	lemma pulledToOvlLeft_colengthBaseChange (i j : D.index) (x : R' ⊗[R] A.colength i) :
188	    (A.pullback R' hproj).toOvlLeft i j (A.colengthBaseChange R' hproj i x) =
189	      A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' hproj hinf i j
190	        ((AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.toOvlLeft i j).toLinearMap) x) := by
191	  induction x with
192	  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
193	  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
194	  | tmul r' y =>
195	    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
196	    have hsmul : (r' ⊗ₜ[R] (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn i}) t) :
197	        R' ⊗[R] A.colength i) =
198	        r' • ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn i}) t)) := by
199	      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
200	    rw [hsmul]
201	    simp only [map_smul]
202	    congr 1
203	    have hlt : (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.toOvlLeft i j).toLinearMap)
204	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn i}) t)) =
205	        (1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (A.toOvlLeft i j (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn i}) t)) :=
206	      rfl
207	    rw [A.colengthBaseChange_one_tmul_mk R' hproj i t, hlt, A.toOvlLeft_mk' i j t,
208	      A.ovlColengthBaseChange_one_tmul_mk R' hproj hinf i j _,
209	      (A.pullback R' hproj).toOvlLeft_mk' i j _]
210	    exact congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk _)
211	      (relAffSectionsMap_res C R'
212	        (inf_le_left : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces i) t)
213	
214	lemma pulledToOvlRight_colengthBaseChange (i j : D.index) (x : R' ⊗[R] A.colength j) :
215	    (A.pullback R' hproj).toOvlRight i j (A.colengthBaseChange R' hproj j x) =
216	      A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' hproj hinf i j
217	        ((AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.toOvlRight i j).toLinearMap) x) := by
218	  induction x with
219	  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
220	  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
221	  | tmul r' y =>
222	    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
223	    have hsmul : (r' ⊗ₜ[R] (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn j}) t) :
224	        R' ⊗[R] A.colength j) =
225	        r' • ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn j}) t)) := by
226	      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
227	    rw [hsmul]
228	    simp only [map_smul]
229	    congr 1
230	    have hlt : (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.toOvlRight i j).toLinearMap)
231	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn j}) t)) =
232	        (1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (A.toOvlRight i j (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn j}) t)) :=
233	      rfl
234	    rw [A.colengthBaseChange_one_tmul_mk R' hproj j t, hlt, A.toOvlRight_mk' i j t,
235	      A.ovlColengthBaseChange_one_tmul_mk R' hproj hinf i j _,
236	      (A.pullback R' hproj).toOvlRight_mk' i j _]
237	    exact congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk _)
238	      (relAffSectionsMap_res C R'
239	        (inf_le_right : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces j) t)
240	
241	set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
242	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
243	/-- **`δ`-naturality**: the pulled difference arrow matches `id ⊗ δ` through the product
244	transports.  A `funext` over the pair index feeding the two squares above — index-shape
245	agnostic, so the widening costs nothing here. -/
246	theorem delta_baseChange_comm :
247	    ((A.pullback R' hproj).deltaLeft - (A.pullback R' hproj).deltaRight) ∘ₗ
248	        (A.chartProdBaseChange R' hproj :
249	          R' ⊗[R] A.chartProd →ₗ[R'] (A.pullback R' hproj).chartProd) =
250	      (A.ovlProdBaseChange R' hproj hinf :
251	          R' ⊗[R] A.ovlProd →ₗ[R'] (A.pullback R' hproj).ovlProd) ∘ₗ
252	        AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) := by
253	  apply LinearMap.ext
254	  intro x
255	  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
256	  induction x with
257	  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
258	  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
259	  | tmul r' s =>
260	    have hsmul : (r' ⊗ₜ[R] s : R' ⊗[R] A.chartProd) = r' • ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s) := by
261	      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
262	    rw [hsmul]
263	    simp only [map_smul]
264	    congr 1
265	    funext p
266	    have hlt : (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))
267	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s) = (1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] ((A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) s) := rfl
268	    have hcomp : (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) s =
269	        fun p : D.index × D.index =>
270	          A.toOvlLeft p.1 p.2 (s p.1) - A.toOvlRight p.1 p.2 (s p.2) := by
271	      funext q
272	      simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, deltaLeft, deltaRight, LinearMap.pi_apply,
273	        LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply,
274	        AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, Pi.sub_apply]
275	    have hL : (((A.pullback R' hproj).deltaLeft - (A.pullback R' hproj).deltaRight)
276	        ((A.chartProdBaseChange R' hproj) ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s))) p =
277	        (A.pullback R' hproj).toOvlLeft p.1 p.2
278	            (A.colengthBaseChange R' hproj p.1 ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s p.1)) -
279	          (A.pullback R' hproj).toOvlRight p.1 p.2
280	            (A.colengthBaseChange R' hproj p.2 ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s p.2)) := by
281	      have h1 := A.chartProdBaseChange_tmul_apply R' hproj 1 s p.1
282	      have h2 := A.chartProdBaseChange_tmul_apply R' hproj 1 s p.2
283	      simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, Pi.sub_apply, deltaLeft, deltaRight,
284	        LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
285	        LinearMap.proj_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, h1, h2]
286	    have hR : ((A.ovlProdBaseChange R' hproj hinf)
287	        ((AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))
288	          ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s))) p =
289	        A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' hproj hinf p.1 p.2
290	            ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (A.toOvlLeft p.1 p.2 (s p.1))) -
291	          A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' hproj hinf p.1 p.2
292	            ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (A.toOvlRight p.1 p.2 (s p.2))) := by
293	      rw [hlt, A.ovlProdBaseChange_tmul_apply R' hproj hinf 1 _ p, hcomp,
294	        TensorProduct.tmul_sub, map_sub]
295	    have hltL : (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.toOvlLeft p.1 p.2).toLinearMap)
296	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s p.1) = (1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (A.toOvlLeft p.1 p.2 (s p.1)) := rfl
297	    have hltR : (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.toOvlRight p.1 p.2).toLinearMap)
298	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s p.2) = (1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (A.toOvlRight p.1 p.2 (s p.2)) := rfl
299	    rw [hL, hR,
300	      A.pulledToOvlLeft_colengthBaseChange R' hproj hinf p.1 p.2 ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s p.1),
301	      A.pulledToOvlRight_colengthBaseChange R' hproj hinf p.1 p.2 ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s p.2),
302	      hltL, hltR]
303	
304	/-- The `δ`-naturality square with the verticals inverted. -/
305	theorem delta_baseChange_comm' :
306	    (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight)) ∘ₗ
307	        ((A.chartProdBaseChange R' hproj).symm :
308	          (A.pullback R' hproj).chartProd →ₗ[R'] R' ⊗[R] A.chartProd) =
309	      ((A.ovlProdBaseChange R' hproj hinf).symm :
310	          (A.pullback R' hproj).ovlProd →ₗ[R'] R' ⊗[R] A.ovlProd) ∘ₗ
311	        ((A.pullback R' hproj).deltaLeft - (A.pullback R' hproj).deltaRight) := by
312	  apply LinearMap.ext
313	  intro x
314	  have h := congr($(A.delta_baseChange_comm R' hproj hinf)
315	    ((A.chartProdBaseChange R' hproj).symm x))
316	  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
317	    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h ⊢
318	  rw [h, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
319	
320	/-! ## The glued transport (clause (c2)) and the flat-cokernel clauses (c3)/(c4)
321	
322	Everything below rides the abstract keystones of `Picard/FlatCokernel.lean` and the
323	square-transport lemmas of `DivisorFamilyPullbackGlued.lean`, all stated for bare modules.
324	The widening is invisible to them. -/
325	
326	include hinf in
327	lemma map_ker_lTensor_delta :
328	    (LinearMap.ker (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))).map
329	        (A.chartProdBaseChange R' hproj :
330	          R' ⊗[R] A.chartProd →ₗ[R'] (A.pullback R' hproj).chartProd) =
331	      (A.pullback R' hproj).gluedSubmodule :=
332	  LinearEquiv.map_ker_of_comp_eq (A.chartProdBaseChange R' hproj)
333	    (A.ovlProdBaseChange R' hproj hinf)
334	    (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))
335	    ((A.pullback R' hproj).deltaLeft - (A.pullback R' hproj).deltaRight)
336	    (A.delta_baseChange_comm R' hproj hinf)
337	
338	include hinf in
339	lemma map_pulledGluedSubmodule_symm :
340	    ((A.pullback R' hproj).gluedSubmodule).map
341	        ((A.chartProdBaseChange R' hproj).symm :
342	          (A.pullback R' hproj).chartProd →ₗ[R'] R' ⊗[R] A.chartProd) =
343	      LinearMap.ker (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight)) :=
344	  LinearEquiv.map_ker_of_comp_eq (A.chartProdBaseChange R' hproj).symm
345	    (A.ovlProdBaseChange R' hproj hinf).symm
346	    ((A.pullback R' hproj).deltaLeft - (A.pullback R' hproj).deltaRight)
347	    (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))
348	    (A.delta_baseChange_comm' R' hproj hinf)
349	
350	include hinf in
351	lemma range_lTensor_delta :
352	    LinearMap.range (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight)) =
353	      (LinearMap.range ((A.pullback R' hproj).deltaLeft -
354	        (A.pullback R' hproj).deltaRight)).map
355	        ((A.ovlProdBaseChange R' hproj hinf).symm :
356	          (A.pullback R' hproj).ovlProd →ₗ[R'] R' ⊗[R] A.ovlProd) :=

376	    (S : ι → Type u)
377	    [∀ i, CommRing (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra k (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra R (S i)]
378	    [∀ i, IsScalarTower k R (S i)] [∀ i, IsLocalization.Away (g i) (S i)]

380	    (h : ∀ i, DivFamZarAff.mapAlg (S i) n F = DivFamZarAff.mapAlg (S i) n G) :

382	  haveI : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (S i)) := fun i =>
383	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (S i) (g i)

387	  refine Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_of_divEq_pullback
388	    (fun i => relCurveMap C R (S i))

391	    (fun i => d₂.2.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors (S i) n)

201	noncomputable def toOvlRight (i j : D.index) : A.colength j →ₐ[R] A.ovlColength i j :=
202	  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (Ideal.span {A.eqn j})
203	    ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (A.ovlIdeal i j)).comp (relResAlgHom C R inf_le_right))

205	      intro a ha
206	      rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at ha
207	      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := ha
208	      simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, map_mul]
209	      have hmem : relResAlgHom C R
210	          (inf_le_right : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces j) (A.eqn j)

214	
215	/-- The product of the piece-local colengths. -/
216	noncomputable abbrev chartProd : Type u := ∀ j : D.index, A.colength j
217	
218	/-- The product of the overlap colengths over ordered index pairs. -/
219	noncomputable abbrev ovlProd : Type u := ∀ p : D.index × D.index, A.ovlColength p.1 p.2
220	
221	/-- The left arrow of the equalizer. -/
222	noncomputable def deltaLeft : A.chartProd →ₗ[R] A.ovlProd :=
223	  LinearMap.pi
224	    (fun p : D.index × D.index => (A.toOvlLeft p.1 p.2).toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.proj p.1)
225	
226	/-- The right arrow of the equalizer. -/
227	noncomputable def deltaRight : A.chartProd →ₗ[R] A.ovlProd :=
228	  LinearMap.pi
229	    (fun p : D.index × D.index => (A.toOvlRight p.1 p.2).toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.proj p.2)
230

232	base-change keystone applies verbatim. -/
233	noncomputable def gluedSubmodule : Submodule R A.chartProd :=
234	  LinearMap.ker (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight)

237	lemma mem_gluedSubmodule_iff (s : A.chartProd) :

257	  /-- (c2) The glued colength module is a finite `R`-module. -/
258	  finite_glued : Module.Finite R A.Glued
259	  /-- (c2) The glued colength module is projective over `R`. -/
260	  projective_glued : Module.Projective R A.Glued
261	  /-- (c2) The glued colength module has constant fibre rank `n`. -/
262	  rankAtStalk_glued : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, Module.rankAtStalk A.Glued p = n

264	  flat_coker_incl : Module.Flat R (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule)

266	  flat_coker_diff :
267	    Module.Flat R (A.ovlProd ⧸ LinearMap.range (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))

6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamily

9	/-!
10	# The widened cover datum: arbitrary affine opens (R2, human decision I-0492)
11	
12	`FinCoverData` (`Picard/DivisorFamily.lean`) types its pieces INTO a fixed pair of pinned
13	`P¹` charts — `h₀ : Fin m₀ → Γ(V₀)`, `h₁ : Fin m₁ → Γ(V₁)`, `pieces = Sum.elim (basicOpen ∘
14	h₀) (basicOpen ∘ h₁)` — with a partition of unity on EACH chart.  Per-piece swallow-or-miss
15	needs only openness (`DivSchemeCertZarConn.lean`), and it is the chart-wise partitions that
16	upgrade "inside one piece" to "inside one chart"; that upgrade is the obstruction, and no
17	repair keeping the pieces inside the preimages of a fixed pair of points of `P¹` can work
18	(`informal/spec-dd-r.md` ADDENDUM 3 §2, ADDENDUM 4 §4.4).
19	
20	This file carries the widened datum.  A piece is an **arbitrary affine open** of the
21	relative curve, the index is a bare `Fin m`, and the covering condition is **joint**
22	(`⨆ j, pieces j = ⊤`) rather than chart-wise.  Nothing types a piece into a chart.
23	
24	Justification for the shape, used and not re-derived (I-0492 clause 2): `supp D` is finite
25	over `R`, hence lies in a single affine open of `C ×_k Spec R` (Stacks `0B8B`), so a cover
26	with one straddling piece always exists.
27	
28	## What the widening RELOCATES rather than removes (I-0492 clause 4(ii))
29	
30	The old typing was silently supplying two things that now have to be earned:
31	
32	* **every point lies in a piece** — was `relCover_sup` plus the two partitions; now it is
33	  exactly the joint covering field (`AffCoverData.exists_mem_pieces`);
34	* **`Γ(pieces j)` is `R`-flat** — was `flat_sections_basicOpen` over
35	  `flat_sections_relPinnedChart`, i.e. it rested on `Γ(V_bᴿ) ≅ R ⊗[k] Γ(C, V_b)` being FREE.
36	  For an arbitrary affine open that route is gone.  Replacement, and it is the one genuinely
37	  new commutative-algebra input the widening costs: `relCurve C R ↘ Spec R` is flat (it is
38	  the base change of `C.hom` along `overSpec k R`, and a morphism to a field spectrum is
39	  flat), and a flat morphism has `R`-flat sections on every affine open
40	  (`flat_sections_of_flat_hom`).  Unconditional in `R` — no Noetherian, no finiteness.
41	
42	Fibrewise-finite support (I-0492 clause 4(i)) is deliberately NOT here: it is not a property
43	of a cover, it must come from the seed's own degree data, and it may not hide inside a
44	`LocalEquations` or an adaptation field.
45	
46	## Main declarations
47	
48	* `AlgebraicGeometry.flat_sections_of_flat_hom` — sections of an arbitrary affine open of a
49	  scheme flat over the base ring are flat.
50	* `AlgebraicGeometry.instFlatRelCurveHom` — the relative curve is flat over its test base.
51	* `AlgebraicGeometry.AffCoverData` — the widened cover datum.
52	* `AffCoverData.exists_mem_pieces`, `isAffineOpen_pieces`, `flat_sections_pieces`,
53	  `flat_sections_pieces_inf` — the derived replacements for what the chart typing supplied.
54	* `AlgebraicGeometry.FinCoverData.toAffCoverData` — the migration: old data instantiates the
55	  widened datum, so nothing landed becomes unreachable.

67	
68	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
69	
70	/-! ## Flat sections on an arbitrary affine open
71	
72	The engine that replaces the pinned-chart freeness argument. -/
73	
74	section FlatSections
75	
76	variable (K : Type u) [CommRing K] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of K))]
77	
78	/-- **Sections of an arbitrary affine open are flat, for a scheme flat over the base ring.**
79	`Scheme.overAlgebraMap` factors as `ΓSpecIso.inv` followed by the structure morphism's
80	`appLE ⊤ V`; the second is `RingHom.Flat` because `AlgebraicGeometry.Flat` is a
81	`HasRingHomProperty` for `RingHom.Flat` and `V` is affine, the first is flat because it is a
82	ring isomorphism, and `RingHom.Flat` composes.
83	
84	This is the widened replacement for `flat_sections_basicOpen ∘ flat_sections_relPinnedChart`:
85	that pair needed the open to be a basic open of a chart whose sections are a FREE base
86	change, which is exactly what an arbitrary affine open does not give. -/
87	theorem flat_sections_of_flat_hom [AlgebraicGeometry.Flat (X ↘ Spec (.of K))]
88	    {V : X.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
89	    Module.Flat K Γ(X, V) := by
90	  have happ : RingHom.Flat ((X ↘ Spec (.of K)).appLE ⊤ V (by simp)).hom :=
91	    HasRingHomProperty.appLE (P := @AlgebraicGeometry.Flat)
92	      (f := X ↘ Spec (.of K)) inferInstance ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ ⟨V, hV⟩ (by simp)
93	  have hiso : RingHom.Flat ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv).hom :=
94	    RingHom.Flat.of_bijective
95	      (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv)
96	  have hcomp : RingHom.Flat (X.overAlgebraMap K V) := by
97	    have hfac : X.overAlgebraMap K V
98	        = ((X ↘ Spec (.of K)).appLE ⊤ V (by simp)).hom.comp
99	            ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv).hom := by
100	      rw [Scheme.overAlgebraMap, Scheme.Hom.appLE]
101	      rfl
102	    rw [hfac]
103	    exact RingHom.Flat.comp hiso happ
104	  exact (RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff (R := K) (S := Γ(X, V))).mp hcomp
105	
106	end FlatSections
107	
108	section RelCurveFlat
109	
110	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
111	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
112	
113	/-- **The relative curve is flat over its test base.** `(snd C (overSpec k R)).left` is the
114	base change of `C.hom` along `(overSpec k R).hom` (`Over.isPullback_left`), and every
115	structure morphism to the spectrum of a field is flat (`flat_hom_over_field`). -/
116	instance instFlatRelCurveHom : AlgebraicGeometry.Flat (relCurve C R ↘ Spec (.of R)) :=
117	  AlgebraicGeometry.Flat.isStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback
118	    (Over.isPullback_left C (overSpec k R)) inferInstance
119	
120	/-- **Flat sections on an arbitrary affine open of the relative curve** — the widened
121	(c1)-flatness input, with no chart and no freeness. -/
122	theorem flat_sections_isAffineOpen {V : (relCurve C R).Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
123	    Module.Flat R Γ(relCurve C R, V) :=
124	  flat_sections_of_flat_hom R (relCurve C R) hV
125	
126	end RelCurveFlat
127	
128	/-! ## The widened cover datum -/
129	
130	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
131	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
132	variable (π : C.left ⟶ P1 k)
133	
134	/-- **The widened cover datum** (R2, human decision I-0492): finitely many **arbitrary
135	affine opens** of the relative curve that **jointly** cover it.
136	
137	Contrast with `FinCoverData`, which this replaces on the certificate side: there is no `h₀`,
138	no `h₁`, no `a₀`/`a₁`, no `partition₀`/`partition₁`, no `Sum` index, and above all no typing
139	of a piece into a pinned chart.  The chart-wise partitions of unity are exactly what upgraded
140	per-piece swallow-or-miss to a chart statement, and they are gone deliberately; the two-chart
141	structure the Θ-layer needs is carried separately (see `ChartTyping` below), never by the
142	certificate clauses.
143	
144	`Type u`, like `FinCoverData`, so a functor value can quotient it. -/
145	structure AffCoverData : Type u where
146	  /-- The number of pieces. -/
147	  m : ℕ
148	  /-- The pieces: arbitrary opens of the relative curve, made affine by `isAffineOpen`. -/
149	  pieces : Fin m → (relCurve C R).Opens
150	  /-- Every piece is affine — the only geometric demand the certificate layer makes. -/
151	  isAffineOpen : ∀ j, IsAffineOpen (pieces j)
152	  /-- The pieces cover the curve JOINTLY.  This replaces the two chart-wise partitions of
153	  unity, and it is the whole structural content of the widening. -/
154	  cover : (⨆ j, pieces j) = ⊤
155	
156	namespace AffCoverData
157	
158	variable {C R π} (D : AffCoverData C R)
159	
160	/-- The gluing index of the widened datum: a bare `Fin`, with no two-sided structure. -/
161	abbrev index : Type := Fin D.m
162	
163	/-- **Every point lies in a piece.** Under `FinCoverData` this came from `relCover_sup`
164	together with the two partitions of unity; here it is exactly the joint covering field —

/-- **The gate in its most consumable form: certify the pulled system after shrinking.**
At every prime it suffices to produce an `r ∉ p` and a certificate for *some* adaptation
of the pulled seed system over `Localization.Away r`.  The adaptation itself is free
(`exists_divisorAdaptation`), so the only genuine obligation is the certificate over the
shrunken base — where the support tube makes per-piece isolation available.

which demanded a certificate for the *canonically extracted* adaptation over the whole
chart ring; that shape forces a globally valid no-leak hypothesis, which is false. -/
theorem isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_exists_certified_adaptation
    (hD : D.IsGenerator)
    (h : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, ∃ r, r ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) :=
        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away r) r
      ∃ A : DivisorAdaptation C (Localization.Away r) pi
          ((D.localEquations hD).pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r))
            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) (D.localEquations hD))),
        A.IsCertified n) :
    IsLocallyCertified C R pi n (D.localEquations hD) := by
  refine isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_away_certified hD fun p => ?_
  obtain ⟨r, hrp, A, hA⟩ := h p
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) :=
    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away r) r

10	/-!
11	# The widened `DivFamZar` (R2, human decision I-0492)
12	
13	The endpoint of the widening.  `IsLocallyCertifiedAff` is the locally-certified predicate
14	whose local certificates are carried by **arbitrary affine-open covers** rather than by basic
15	opens of a fixed pair of pinned `P¹` charts, and `DivFamZarAff` is its `DivEq` quotient —
16	the object the human decision of 2026-07-28 is about.
17	
18	## Why this is strictly weaker than the old predicate, which is the whole point
19	
20	`FinCoverData.toAffCoverData` (`DivisorFamilyAffCover.lean`) turns every old cover datum into
21	a widened one, and `DivisorFamilyAffCompare.lean` migrates the CERTIFICATE on top of it, so
22	`isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_isLocallyCertified` holds: anything the old
23	predicate certified, the new one certifies.  The converse fails, and its failure is exactly
24	the content of R2 — a divisor straddling both pinned vertical fibres has no chart-typed
25	certificate (`informal/spec-dd-r.md` ADDENDUM 4 §4.3, on-stratum witness at every `g ≥ 2`)
26	but does admit an affine-open one, because `supp D` is finite over `R` and therefore lies in a
27	single affine open of `C ×_k Spec R` (Stacks `0B8B`).
28	
29	So `DivFamZarAff` is the value on which the divisor functor can be a Zariski sheaf over an
30	ARBITRARY field, with no `|P¹(k)| ≥ n + 2` hypothesis anywhere — the field-uniform fix.
31	
32	## The two relocated obligations (I-0492 clause 4)
33	
34	* **(i) fibrewise-finite support.** NOT a field of anything here.  It is not implied by
35	  what a `LocalEquations` carries (`d.eqn ≡ r` for a non-unit `r ∈ R` is germ-regular with a
36	  whole fibre curve in its support), so it must come from the seed's own degree data.  It
37	  enters as an explicit hypothesis at the point of use, never as carrier data: concretely as
38	  the `hfib` argument of `AffAdaptation.isCertified_of_swallowedBy`
39	  (`DivisorFamilyAffAssemble.lean`) and as `AffCoverData.SwallowedBy`
40	  (`DivisorFamilyAffSwallow.lean`).  Neither is a field of anything in this file.
41	* **(ii) what the fixed-pair confinement was silently supplying.** Discharged in
42	  `DivisorFamilyAffCover.lean` (`exists_mem_pieces` from the joint cover,
43	  `flat_sections_pieces` from the flat structure morphism) and in
44	  `DivisorFamilyAffPerPiece.lean` (the whole per-piece layer, from openness and affineness).
45	
46	## Main declarations
47	
48	* `AlgebraicGeometry.CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff` — a certified family over a widened cover.
49	* `AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocallyCertifiedAff` — the widened locally-certified predicate.
50	* `IsLocallyCertifiedAff.of_divEq` — it respects divisor equality.
51	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZarAff` — the widened functor value, with `mk`, `mk_eq_mk_iff`
52	  and `picClass`.
53	
54	The comparison with the chart-typed predicate — `isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_isLocallyCertified`
55	and `DivFamZar.toAff` — is in `DivisorFamilyAffCompare.lean`, which imports this file.
56	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_forall_prime_exists_away` — the pointwise gate,
57	  one base point at a time, over the widened predicate.
58	-/

100

102	CURVE, and changes nothing about the Zariski cover of the base. -/

116	theorem IsLocallyCertifiedAff.of_divEq {n : ℕ} {d d' : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
117	    (hd : IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d) (h : Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d d') :
118	    IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d' := by
119	  obtain ⟨m, g, hg, hG⟩ := hd

121	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) :=
122	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i)) (g i)
123	  obtain ⟨G, hGdiv⟩ := hG i
124	  exact ⟨G, hGdiv.trans
125	    (Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i)))
126	      h _ _)⟩
127	
128	/-! ## The comparison with the chart-typed predicate
129	
130	`FinCoverData.toAffCoverData` (`DivisorFamilyAffCover.lean`) already migrates the COVER
131	sorry-free, and the adaptation's equations and `eqn_rel` transport with it because the pieces
132	are literally the same opens, only reindexed along `finSumFinEquiv`.
133	
134	The migration of the CERTIFICATE is landed too, in `DivisorFamilyAffCompare.lean`
135	(`DivisorAdaptation.isCertified_toAff`, all seven clauses).  Clauses (c1) are `rfl` at the
136	relabelled index; the glued clauses (c2)/(c3)/(c4) transport along `LinearEquiv.piCongrLeft`
137	in its `symm` direction, which evaluates cast-free, so the intertwining with
138	`deltaLeft`/`deltaRight` is componentwise and `Module.rankAtStalk` invariance is
139	`rankAtStalk_eq_of_equiv`.  No clause changes, only the index does.
140	
141	A predecessor docstring here estimated that transport at about a hundred lines of equalizer
142	bookkeeping.  That was wrong by an order of magnitude and the reason generalises: arrange the
143	reindexed cover so its pieces are DEFINITIONALLY the original pieces at the relabelled index,
144	and the overlap data at `(i, j)` becomes `rfl`-equal to the original at `(e i, e j)`, because
145	reindexing acts diagonally on the pair index.  Then no intertwining lemma exists to prove. -/

154	  r d₁ d₂ := Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d₁.1 d₂.1

161	arbitrary affine-open covers of the relative curve.
162

173	    DivFamZarAff C R n :=
174	  Quotient.mk (divFamZarAffSetoid C R n) ⟨d, hd⟩

177	    {h₁ : IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d₁} {h₂ : IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d₂} :
178	    mk d₁ h₁ = mk d₂ h₂ ↔ Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d₁ d₂ :=
